subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 5 — Semiconductor Main Memory, Error Correction & Storage Architectures
moduleDescription: Semiconductor memory cell physics (SRAM vs DRAM), memory cell refresh kinetics, ROM taxonomies, chip organization and address multiplexing (RAS/CAS), error detection and correction principles, Hamming Single Error Correction and Double Error Detection (SEC-DED) codes, syndrome decoding, magnetic disk physical kinematics, rotational latency and seek timing, and Redundant Array of Independent Disks (RAID 0, 1, 5, 6, 10).
